rows.text: The recital of Royal Order A/180 refers to the meeting held on 29/11/1428 AH to complete the procedures for constituting the Allegiance Commission, attended by the sons of the founder and the sons of those of them who had died.

rows.role_title: رئيس هيئة البيعة — Chairman of the Allegiance Commission
rows.text: Royal Order A/180 dated 29/11/1428 AH by King Abdullah, item First: the Allegiance Commission is constituted from the listed sons and grandsons of the founder, the first being 'صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير مشعل بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود رئيساً'.
